conventions.samples: the .npy files are planar [channels, samples] in OpusHead's channel order; npy_dtype float32 is opus_decode_float's output as is; int16 is used only where every float sample is a multiple of 1/32768 (SILK frames without redundant CELT frames): divide by 32768 for the float samples, exactly; a decode with npy_window holds only samples [start, end) of the decoding (its hashes are the whole's)
conventions.trimming: pre-skip x rate / 48000 samples dropped from the start; (last granule - pre-skip) x rate / 48000 kept (every fixture divides exactly: exact_scaling)
conventions.gain: OpusHead's output gain applied inside libopus (OPUS_SET_GAIN), as opusfile does: every sample x 10^(gain / 5120), in float; gain_applied false decodes ignore it
conventions.hashes: float32_sha256 and int16_sha256 are of the planar little-endian samples (the .npy's data bytes for its dtype)
conventions.int16: opus_decode's output (the float build: the float samples soft-clipped by opus_pcm_soft_clip, then rounded to nearest-even and saturated)
conventions.packets: rows of fields: page (the page the packet ends on), bytes, TOC config/mode/bandwidth/frame_ms/stereo/code, vbr (code 2, or code 3's flag), padding bytes (code 3), frame sizes (opus_packet_parse), samples at 48 kHz, final_range (OPUS_GET_FINAL_RANGE after the packet; a list per stream for a multistream), frame_ranges (packets of several frames: each frame decoded alone as its own code-0 packet, its final range; the last is the packet's; the samples are the packet's, checked), silk_tell (per frame: ec_tell in bits where the SILK part ended, as libopus' decoder found it; -1 for a frame without data), redundancy ([frame, 1 if CELT to SILK else 0, bytes] for each frame that carries a redundant CELT frame: in a SILK-only frame, 17 or more bits left after SILK mean one; both from a traced copy of libopus' decoder whose samples are checked equal)
conventions.pages: rows: byte offset, size, header flags (1 continued, 2 BOS, 4 EOS), granule, serial, sequence, lacing values, packets ending on it
conventions.checks: fixed_point and libopus 1.5.2: the same file through those builds (float32_equal, max_abs_diff); opus_demo: libopus' tool on the packets with their final ranges (it stops on a mismatch), its 24-bit output (opus_decode24, no output gain) against the reference; ffmpeg_native: ffmpeg's own decoder (another implementation: its SILK is not libopus', so its samples are not close); ffmpeg_libopus: the system's libopus (another build, with its SIMD paths) through ffmpeg, as float

refuse-celt-fb-20ms-mono.opus.expected: NotSupportedException naming the celt frames: the decoder reads SILK only

refuse-hybrid-swb-20ms-mono.opus.expected: NotSupportedException naming the hybrid frames: the decoder reads SILK only

gain-minus6db-silk-mb-20ms-mono.opus.what: silk-mb-20ms-mono.opus with OpusHead's output gain -1536 (Q7.8: -6 dB); its pages otherwise the same

silk-bandwidth-switch-mono-stripped.opus.what: the source with each redundant CELT frame cut off (the packet ends where its SILK data ends): libopus then decodes no redundancy, so this is what a SILK-only decoder that skips redundant frames gives for the source

repack-code1-silk-wb-20ms-doubled.opus.what: every packet of the source joined with itself by libopus' repacketizer: code 1 (two equal frames), a new stream twice as long (each frame decoded twice in a row), its end trimmed by as much as the source's

bad-crc.opus.what: page 3: a body byte flipped (0x10), the CRC not updated

bad-truncated.opus.what: cut at byte 1641, inside the last page's body

bad-packet-code1-odd.opus.what: packet 5: TOC code 1 with an odd payload (37 bytes): two equal frames cannot fill it

bad-packet-160ms.opus.what: packet 5: code 3 with 4 frames of 40 ms (160 ms; a packet holds at most 120 ms)

unsupported-family255.opus.what: OpusHead's mapping family 255 (streams 1, coupled 0, mapping [0]): valid Ogg Opus, not read (NotSupportedException naming the family)

chained.opus.what: two links: silk-mb-20ms-mono.opus then silk-nb-40ms-stereo.opus (each link decodes as its source)

multiplexed.opus.what: two streams grouped (both BOS pages first, then their pages alternating): voicenote-16k-60ms.opus and silk-nb-10ms-mono.opus

not-opus-vorbis.ogg.what: one BOS page holding a Vorbis identification header (mono, 44.1 kHz): an Ogg stream that is not Opus (ReadInfo answers null)

mode_survey.what: libopus' encoder unforced (no mode, bandwidth or signal type set), mono, VBR, complexity 10, on 3 s of the speech-like signal and of it over a steady background, from 16 kHz input (OpusHead input rate 16000, as voice notes) and 48 kHz; per encoding the packets counted by their TOC's mode, bandwidth and both; kbps is the packets' mean rate; not_silk: [packet, its time in s, mode, the input's peak in dBFS under it] for each packet that is not SILK (up to 40); redundant_celt_frames: [packet, 1 if CELT to SILK, bytes] for each frame carrying a redundant CELT frame (RFC 6716 4.5.1). Not kept as files.
